notes_body: PANELS SHOWN: B and C of Key figure 1 (A, behavior, is the behavior slide's far-contra story; D is the next slide). Encoding page Key figure 1 (scripts/key_figure.py).

B CUED licks, fraction of pre (mean of animals, 95 % paired nested CI): frozen far-contra spout code on far-contra hits 0.36 / 0.69 / 0.71 (acute from PS93 only: PS92 (2 sessions, 10 acute far-contra hits; 0.21 of pre) and PS94 (1 session, 8 hits; 0.69) are below the 20-hit minimum and drawn as gray hollow diamonds, shown but not in the mean, CI or k/n; PS95 has 0; subacute / chronic 4/4 below pre); frozen lateral lick decoder 0.80 / 0.89 / 0.93; decoder REFIT per epoch (vs matched-n pre) 0.90 / 0.96 / 1.00 (Fig 10.2b). C ITI licks (all ITI): frozen 0.76 / 0.81 / 0.77 (4/4 below pre every epoch); refit 0.89 / 0.96 / 0.98. D ITI like-for-like offset (all ITI licks): +0.36 [+0.17, +0.55] (4/4) / +0.24 (3/4) / +0.27 (4/4) mm; against pre licks of the SAME previous-trial target (12.15) +0.25 (4/4) / +0.17 (3/4) / +0.23 (4/4).
Covariate, non-linear and face / tongue-only decoder checks: encoding page 12.16 [#f-lick_covref_offset], 11.20 [#f-lick_nonlinear_decoder], 11.21 [#f-lick_behaviour_decoder].

SIGN: + = READ more contralesional than the lick landed (decoder like-for-like offset, a DIRECTION quantity); landing / decoded lateral position + = contralesional; image left = ipsilesional. Decoder: frozen pre-stroke KEY-row lateral lick-position decoder per lick set (z-scored Allen areas with the ALM / tjM1 split, lags 0-0.2 s, August pre sessions, pre scored leave-one-session-out). LIKE-FOR-LIKE offset = each lick's decoded lateral position minus a Gaussian-weighted mean (sigma 0.1 mm, chosen by held-out pre prediction) of the decoded positions of the animal's PRE licks of the same set that LANDED at the same lateral place (any spout, no bins). Session means; change vs the animal's own pre, 95 % paired nested bootstrap (animals -> sessions), * = CI excludes 0, k/n animals. ITI = all licks between trials (bout start = no lick for >= 1 s). PROVISIONAL (n = 4).
Licks: LP video licks (cam4 detector) with 3-D tongue position from cam1 + cam4 pose; DAQ licks use the shared detector (daqlk).
